contract: construct() -> classes [[p, r], ...] with distinct primes p <= 1000, 0 <= r < p and sum of 1/p at most 1 (exact rationals). The score is the largest L such that every integer 1..L lies in some class (exact, capped at 10^5). Maximize; L >= 999 would realize the Erdős-Ruzsa covering statement at x = 1000 with C = 1.
notes: Covered lengths for x = 1000 and C = 1 are finite evidence for the conjecture; reaching 999 would realize it at this size. Exact local certificates are not Lean proofs; the Mahler measure and reciprocal sums are reported as floats. Consult the independent oracle and malformed-input tests.
